emailMessage.Subject: [Scope Drift] ALERT: Detection summary persistence failed
emailMessage.Body:
Alert: The Scope Drift Monitor detection run at @{utcNow()} completed processing but failed to persist the detection summary record to Dataverse after all retries.

Violations detected this cycle: @{variables('ViolationsFound')}

Events processed: @{min(length(variables('AuditEvents')), 200)}

Violation records were still created successfully. Only the summary/audit trail record is missing. Please investigate the Dataverse connection and fsi_detectionruns table.

emailMessage.Subject: [Scope Drift] WARNING: Audit events exceeded processing cap
emailMessage.Body:
Warning: The Scope Drift Monitor detection run at @{utcNow()} received @{length(variables('AuditEvents'))} audit events but only processed 200 due to the per-run cap.

Events skipped: @{sub(length(variables('AuditEvents')), 200)}

Skipped events were not analyzed for scope violations. This may occur during high-activity periods and could mask real violations. Consider increasing detection frequency or reviewing the skipped time window manually.

description: SDM-DriftDetector: Scheduled detection flow that polls Unified Audit Log for CopilotInteraction events and creates violations for out-of-scope access. Known limitation: Check_Existing_Violations_For_Event uses one Dataverse query per audit event (N+1 pattern, up to 200 queries per cycle) because Power Automate lacks batch query support without a custom connector.
